_about: Public-domain Giovanni Battista Scaramelli (1687-1752, Jesuit) in English for the Word Hoard: The Directorium Asceticum; or, Guide to the Spiritual Life, translated and edited at St Beuno's College, with a preface by Archbishop Manning (4 vols, Dublin: William B. Kelly, 1870-1871), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
